procedure: Fix the bug in task.py so test_task.py passes
Fix the bug in strings.py so test_strings.py passes

context_policy: Each successor must start in an independent new context and receive only its assigned projection plus the held-out task after assignment.
analysis_method: Complete all three preregistered contrasts within each target pair; primary outcomes come only from frozen external checks.
uncertainty_rule: Any missing contrast, invalid derangement, cross-arm writeback, resource mismatch, or disagreement between the two replicas makes the run inconclusive.
exclusion_rules: Exclude a successor exposed to another arm's history or result.
Exclude a successor exposed to the held-out task before assignment.
Do not replace an excluded successor after outcomes are visible.
abort_rules: Abort before provider invocation while registration_status is not run_registered.
Abort if the frozen parent or treatment state cannot be reproduced exactly.
Abort if a valid two-pair memory-to-task derangement cannot be formed.
privacy_policy: Do not publish or project raw prompts, transcripts, tool arguments, secrets, token ledgers, SQLite contents, or private session text.

blocking_observation.finding: The two candidate treatments retain task labels and a restatement of the task, but no transferable repair procedure. Their source CAMUs also contain no repair method or observed use evidence.
blocking_observation.causal_consequence: A meaningful equivalent-instruction control and content-sensitive derangement cannot be frozen without inventing information that the Agent did not retain.
blocking_observation.only_unblock_condition: Record at least two independently learned, content-bearing histories whose procedures were available to the Agent before future held-out tasks, then freeze their exact projections and controls before exposure.
